mistake_reason: At step 15, DataVerification_Expert withheld critical information from the opened Britannica page, which explicitly stated an estimated explosive force of about 15 megatons of TNT and implied comparability to large thermonuclear tests. Instead of sharing the precise 15-megaton figure (and the clear link to Castle Bravo), they provided only a vague summary like "around a dozen megatons" and insisted that exact phrasing was not important. This information withholding (FM-2.4) misled the team to select Ivy Mike (10.4 Mt) and output "Mike," rather than correctly matching the Britannica value to Castle Bravo and outputting "Bravo."
